name: Capture Project Knowledge Explorer requirements
description: Use the explicitly invoked To-TRD skill to discover and capture requirements from the user-supplied Sys4AI Project Knowledge Explorer Recommendations. Treat the recommendations as source material and resolve material scope choices with the user. This Task authorizes a project-local requirements document only, not implementation or publication.
definition_of_done: The user's intended outcome, selected scope, exclusions and material constraints are settled and traced to the current request, supplied recommendations and actual clarification answers.
A new project-local schema-2 TRD is created through the To-TRD helper with stable requirement IDs, sources and observable acceptance criteria, then directly inspected and validated with its index.
The exact reviewed TRD revision receives explicit user approval and its saved state is verified as trd_done; downstream planning, implementation and external actions remain separately authorized.
current_summary: Requirements capture complete. User-approved TRD-20260919-B6D51106 revision 2 is verified trd_done with 49 requirements, complete source coverage, current index and preserved existing records.
